name: overnight_ed_critical_alerts_sync
description: Automated aggregation of overnight ED system alerts including critical lab values, imaging flags, and patient deterioration warnings from 00:00-07:00
notes: Runs daily at 7 AM to prepare handoff data for morning shift. Aggregates data from EMR, lab system, PACS, and vital signs monitoring.

execution_history.notes: 18 critical alerts flagged: 3 lab critical values, 2 imaging urgent findings, 13 vital sign warnings

name: ed_handoff_task_verification
description: Validates completion status of automated handoff tasks including discharge summaries, procedure documentation, and consult follow-ups
notes: Runs at 6:30 AM to identify incomplete documentation before morning shift. Failure indicates incomplete tasks requiring manual follow-up.

execution_history.notes: ALERT: 4 discharge summaries incomplete, 2 procedure notes missing signatures, 1 ICU consult pending response

name: daily_teaching_schedule_sync
description: Synchronizes resident teaching schedule from education coordinator system to ED calendar
notes: Daily sync of teaching sessions, case conferences, and simulation labs
